311 do j=1,indt
312 do i=1,ipc*nelup,ipc
313 if(winvup(i,j).lt.0) distsquare_node=distsquare_node+winvup(i,j)*winvup(i,j)
314 enddo
315 enddo
316 do j=1,indt
317 do i=1,ipc*neldo,ipc
318 if(winvdo(i,j).lt.0) distsquare_node=distsquare_node+winvdo(i,j)*winvup(i,j)
319 enddo
320 enddo
321 if(distsquare_node.gt.0.d0) then
322 distsquare_node=1.d0/distsquare_node/(cutweight*cutweight)
323 weight_wagner=f_wagner(distsquare_node)
324 else
325 weight_wagner=1.d0
326 endif
327 else
328 do i=1,ipc*nelup
329 distsquare_node=distsquare_node+sum(winvup(i,indt+1:indt+3)*winvup(i,indt+1:indt+3))
330 enddo
331 do i=1,ipc*neldo
332 distsquare_node=distsquare_node+sum(winvdo(i,indt+1:indt+3)*winvdo(i,indt+1:indt+3))
333 enddo
334 distsquare_node=1.d0/distsquare_node/(cutweight*cutweight)
335 weight_wagner=f_wagner(distsquare_node)
336 endif
337 else
338 weight_wagner=1.d0
339 endif
340 if(ieseloc) then
341 elocb(1:ipc)=elocb(1:ipc)*weight_wagner
342 else
343 logpsib(1:ipc)=logpsib(1:ipc)*weight_wagner
344 endif
345 endif

348 CALL task11_b(winvup, winvupb, winvdo, winvdob, tabpip, tabpipb, &
349 & tmu, tmub, vpot, vpotb, eloc, elocb)

355 &, ainvupb, ainvdo, ainvdob, winvup, winvupb, winvdo, winvdob, cellscaleb, s2rb, psip, psipb)

365 &, psip(ind1), psipb(ind1), psip(ind4), psipb(ind4), psip, psipb, psip(ind2), psipb(ind2)&
366 &, cellscaleb, s2rb, metricb, car2cryb,ipsip,psip(ind3),psipb(ind3))
367

369!$omp target update to (winvjb,winvjbarb)

388

395#ifdef _TIME

445#endif

448 kelindb(:, :) = kelindb(:, :) + kelb(:, :, 0)
449 kelb(:, :, 0) = 0.0_8
450
451
452 endif
453
454 if(iespbc) then
455 ! reverse of given s2r compute omega the volume and recip
456 ! omega=det(s2r)
457 ! cost=TWO_PI/omega
458 ! recip(1,:)=cross_product(s2r(:,2), s2r(:,3))*cost
459 ! recip(2,:)=cross_product(s2r(:,3), s2r(:,1))*cost
460 ! recip(3,:)=cross_product(s2r(:,1), s2r(:,2))*cost
461 cost = two_pi / omega
462 workscra(:) = recipb(1, :)
463 s2rb(:, 2) = s2rb(:, 2) - cross_product(workscra, s2r(1, 3)) * cost
464 s2rb(:, 3) = s2rb(:, 3) - cross_product(s2r(1, 2), workscra) * cost
465
466 workscra(:) = recipb(2, :)
467 s2rb(:, 1) = s2rb(:, 1) - cross_product(s2r(1, 3), workscra) * cost
468 s2rb(:, 3) = s2rb(:, 3) - cross_product(workscra, s2r(1, 1)) * cost
469
470 workscra(:) = recipb(3, :)
471 s2rb(:, 1) = s2rb(:, 1) - cross_product(workscra, s2r(1, 2)) * cost
472 s2rb(:, 2) = s2rb(:, 2) - cross_product(s2r(1, 1), workscra) * cost
473
474 costb = sum(recipb(:, :) * recip(:, :)) / cost
475
476 recipb = 0.d0
477 matscra = transpose(s2r)
478 call dgetrf(3, 3, matscra, 3, ipiv, info)
479 call dgetri(3, matscra, 3, ipiv, workscra, 3, info)
480 ! s2rb=s2rb-cost*costb*matscra
481 omegab = omegab - costb * cost / omega
482 ! compute omega=det(s2r)
483 s2rb = s2rb + omegab * omega * matscra
484 omegab = 0.d0
485 ! reverse of given s2r compute metric
486 !
487 ! Reverse of Given at compute car2cry=at^-1
488 matscra = matmul(transpose(car2cry), car2cryb)
489 atb = -matmul(matscra, transpose(car2cry))
490
491 ! Reverse of Given at compute the metric
492 ! metric=transpose(at) at
493 matscra = metricb + transpose(metricb)
494 atb = atb + matmul(at, matscra)
495
496 ! Given s2r and cellscale compute at
497 ! at=s2r(:,k)/cellscale(k)
498 do k = 1, 3
499 s2rb(:, k) = s2rb(:, k) + atb(:, k) / cellscale(k)
500 cellscaleb(k) = cellscaleb(k) - sum(atb(:, k) * s2r(:, k)) / (cellscale(k)*cellscale(k))
501 enddo
502 ! reverse of cellscale=sqrt(sum(s2r(:,1)**2)) Important for pseudo and twobody
503 do k = 1, 3
504 s2rb(:, k) = s2rb(:, k) + cellscaleb(k) / cellscale(k) * s2r(:, k)
505 enddo
506 endif
507 ! At the end symmetrize AGP if requested.
508 if(ipf.eq.2) then
509 if(yesfast.eq.0) then
510 call symmetrizepfaff(ipc, ndim_detmat, detmatb)
511 else
512 call symmetrizepfaff(ipc, ndim_detmat, detmat_cb)
513 endif
514 if(npar_eagp.gt.0) then
515 call symmetrizepfaff(ipc, ndiff, eagp_pfaffb)
516 endif
517 endif
518 if(notest) then
519 if(symmagp.and.(ipc.eq.1.or.(ipc.eq.2.and..not.yes_correct))) then
520 ! In the complex case with yes_correct=.true. we cannot symmetrize
521 if(yesfast.eq.0) then
522 call symmetrize(ipc, ipf, yes_hermite, nelorbh, nelorb_at, detmatb)
523 else
524 call symmetrize(ipc, ipf, yes_hermite, nelorb_c / ipf, nelorb_at, detmat_cb)
525 endif
526 endif
527 if(nelorbj.gt.0) then
528 if(yesfastj.eq.0) then
529 if(.not.yes_sparse) call symmetrize(1, 1, .false., ipj * nelorbjh, ipj * nelorbjh, jasmatb)
530 if(iessz) call symmetrize_(1, 1, .false., nelorbjh, nelorbjh, jasmatszb)
531 else
532 call symmetrize(1, 1, .false., ipj * nelorbj_c, ipj * nelorbj_c, jasmat_cb)
533 if(iessz) call symmetrize_(1, 1, .false., nelorbj_c, nelorbj_c, jasmatsz_cb)
534 endif
535 endif
536 endif
537 ! derivative in the direction of the principal axes
538 if(iespbc) then
539 do k = 1, 3
540 cellscaleb(k) = sum(at(:, k) * s2rb(:, k)) ! for compatibility with the dynamic
541 enddo
542 endif
543
544 if(allocated(winvb_big)) deallocate(winvb_big)
545 if(allocated(winvjb_big)) deallocate(winvjb_big)
546
547
548 return

550CONTAINS
551 ! Differentiation of task9 in reverse (adjoint) mode:
552 ! gradient, with respect to input variables: vju cnorm ivic r
553 ! rmusin rmucos rmu zeta lbox winvjbarsz work1 work2
554 ! work3 winvj rion psidetlnt kel tmu tabpip prefactor
555 ! winvjbar
556 ! of linear combination of output variables: cnorm r rmusin rmucos
557 ! rmu zeta logpsi work1 work2 work3 rion kel tmu
558 ! tabpip
559 SUBROUTINE task9_b(kel, kelb, rion, rionb, winvj, winvjb, winvjbar, &
560 & winvjbarb, winvjbarsz, winvjbarszb, ivic, ivicb, &
561 & tabpip, tabpipb, vj, vjb, vju, vjub, psidetlnt, psidetlntb, logpsi, logpsib, work1, &
562 & work1b, work2, work2b, work3, work3b, vecu, vecub, cellscaleb, s2rb, metricb, car2cryb,ispin_n,vold_n,voldb_n)
563 IMPLICIT NONE
564 ! input kel rion winvj,winvjbar,winvjbarsz (if spin Jastrow on)
565 ! prefactor
566 ! output tabpip(nel,indt+4),logpsi
567 ! logpsi is the logarithm |psi| without the Determinantal part
568 ! all the rest is just used to evaluate tabpip
569 real*8, INTENT(IN) :: kel(3, nel), rion(3, nion), winvj(&
570 & nelorbjmax, 0:indt4j, nel), winvjbar(*), winvjbarsz(sizewsz), &
571 & psidetlnt
572 real*8 :: kelb(3, nel), rionb(3, nion), winvjb(nelorbjmax, 0&
573 &:0, nel), winvjbarb(int(ipj * nelorbjh,8)*nel+1), winvjbarszb(sizewsz), &
574 & psidetlntb(*)
575 real*8 :: tabpip(nel, indt + 4), logpsi
576 real*8 :: tabpipb(nel, indt + 4), logpsib(*)
577 real*8 :: work1(ipj * nelorbjmax, sizework1), work2(nelorbjmax, 0:indt + 4)
578 real*8 :: work1b(ipj * nelorbjmax, sizework1), work2b(nelorbjmax, 0:indt + 4)
579 real*8 :: jastrow_ei, jastrow_ee, work3(isdistp)
580 real*8 :: work3b(isdistp), rco(3), rcob(3), jastrownb, r0o, r0ob
581 real*8 :: ivicb(3, indtmax, nelup + neldo), ivic(3, indtmax, nelup + neldo)
582 real*8 :: rc0(3), rc0o(3), rc1(3), rco0(3), cellscaleb(3)&
583 &, s2rb(3, 3), metricb(3, 3), car2cryb(3, 3), rc_before(3), rco_before(3), rc0_before(3)&
584 &, rco0_before(3),rc(3),rcb(3)
585 real*8 :: vj(*), vjb(niesd), vju(*), vjub(*), vecu(max(nel, indt + 5), 2), vecub(max(nel, indt + 5), 2)
586 INTEGER :: indtaj, indtmp, nelused
587 integer*8 ji, jf,ii,maxii,indj
588 real*8 :: tempb0(3)
589 INTRINSIC sum
590 real*8 :: tempb, costz0t, costz0e, costz0b, w0, wj, costexp, ddot2, ddotj, ddot2b, ddotjb, w0b, wjb&
591 &, ddotb
592 real*8 vold_n(nel+nion),voldb_n(nel+nion)
593 integer ispin_n(nel)
594 voldb_n=0.d0
595
596 tabpipsav = tabpip
597
598 psidetlntb(1:ipc) = logpsib(1:ipc) + psidetlntb(1:ipc)
599
600 nelused = nelup + mod(ipj, 2) * neldo
601
602 if(nelorbjh.gt.0) then
603
604 ! recompute work1
605
606 do k=1,nelorbju
607 work1(k, 1) = winvjbar(k)
608 enddo
609!$omp parallel do default(shared) private(k,j)
610 do k=1,nelorbju
611 do j = 2, nel
612 work1(k, 1) = work1(k, 1) + winvjbar((j - 1) * nelorbju + k)
613 enddo
614 enddo
615 if(iessz) then
616 work1(:, 2) = winvjbarsz(1:nelorbjh)
617 do j = 2, nelup
618 work1(:, 2) = work1(:, 2) + winvjbarsz((j - 1) * nelorbjh + 1:j * nelorbjh)
619 enddo
620 do j = nelup + 1, nel
621 work1(:, 2) = work1(:, 2) - winvjbarsz((j - 1) * nelorbjh + 1:j * nelorbjh)
622 enddo
623 endif
624
625 work1b = 0.d0
626 work2b = 0.d0
627 work3b = 0.d0
628 vecub = 0.d0
629
630 if(ieslog) then
631 ! Calculation wavefunction
632 if(iessz) then
633 do j = nelup + 1, nel
634 vecub(j, 1) = -0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
635 vecub(j, 2) = -0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
636 enddo
637 ! do j=nelup+1,nel
638 ! logpsi(1)=logpsi(1)-0.5d0*(vecu(j,1)+vecu(j,2))
639 ! enddo
640 do j = 1, nelup
641 vecub(j, 1) = 0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
642 vecub(j, 2) = -0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
643 enddo
644 ! do j=1,nelup
645 ! logpsi(1)=logpsi(1)+0.5d0*(vecu(j,1)-vecu(j,2))
646 ! enddo
647 do j = 1, nel
648 indj = int(j - 1,8) * nelorbjh + 1
649 call ddot_b(nelorbjh, winvj(1, 0, j), winvjb(1, 0, j), winvjbarsz(indj), winvjbarszb(indj), vecub(j, 2))
650 ! winvjb(:,0,j)=winvjb(:,0,j)+vecub(j,2)*winvjbarsz(ji:jf)
651 ! winvjbarszb(ji:jf)=winvjbarszb(ji:jf)+vecub(j,2)*winvj(:,0,j)
652 ! vecub(j,2)=0.d0
653 enddo
654 ! do j=1,nel
655 ! vecu(j,2)=sum(winvj(:,0,j)*winvjbarsz((j-1)*nelorbjh+1:j*nelorbjh))
656 ! enddo
657 call dgemv_b('T', nelorbjh, nel, 1.d0, winvj, nelorbj5, winvjb, nelorbjh, work1(1, 2), 1&
658 &, work1b(1, 2), 1, 0.d0, vecub, 1)
659 ! call dgemv('T',nelorbjh,nel,1.d0,winvj,nelorbj5,work1(1,2),1,0.d0,vecu,1)
660 endif ! iessz
661
662 do j = 1, nel
663 vecub(j, 1) = 0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
664 vecub(j, 2) = -0.5d0 * logpsib(1)
665 enddo
666 ! do j=1,nel
667 ! logpsi(1)=logpsi(1)+0.5d0*(vecu(j,1)-vecu(j,2))
668 ! enddo
669
670 do j = 1, nel
671 if (ipj==2) then
672 if (j<=nelup) then
673 indj = int(j - 1,8) * int(nelorbjh * ipj,8) + 1
674 ! jf=j*nelorbjh
675 call ddot_b(nelorbjh, winvj(1, 0, j), winvjb(1, 0, j), winvjbar(indj), winvjbarb(indj), vecub(j, 2))
676 else
677 indj = (j - 1) * nelorbjh * ipj + nelorbjh + 1
678 call ddot_b(nelorbjh, winvj(1, 0, j), winvjb(1, 0, j), winvjbar(indj), winvjbarb(indj), vecub(j, 2))
679 endif
680 else
681 indj = int(j - 1,8) * nelorbjh + 1
682 call ddot_b(nelorbjh, winvj(1, 0, j), winvjb(1, 0, j), winvjbar(indj), winvjbarb(indj), vecub(j, 2))
683 endif
684 ! winvjb(:,0,j)=winvjb(:,0,j)+vecub(j,2)*winvjbar(ji:jf)
685 ! winvjbarb(ji:jf)=winvjbarb(ji:jf)+vecub(j,2)*winvj(:,0,j)
686 ! vecub(j,2)=0.d0
687 enddo
688 ! do j=1,nel
689 ! vecu(j,2)=sum(winvj(:,0,j)*winvjbar((j-1)*nelorbjh+1:j*nelorbjh))
690 ! enddo
691
692 call dgemv_b('T', nelorbjh, nelused, 1.d0, winvj, nelorbj5, winvjb, nelorbjh, work1, 1&
693 &, work1b, 1, 0.d0, vecub, 1)
694 if (ipj==2) then
695 call dgemv_b('T', nelorbjh, neldo, 1.d0, winvj(1, 0, nelup1), nelorbj5&
696 &, winvjb(1, 0, nelup1), nelorbjh, work1(1 + nelorbjh, 1), 1&
697 &, work1b(1 + nelorbjh, 1), 1, 0.d0, vecub(nelup1, 1), 1)
698 endif
699
700 ! call dgemv('T',nelorbjh,nel,1.d0,winvj,nelorbj5,work1,1,0.d0,vecu,1)
701 endif ! endif ieslog
702
703 if(ieseloc) then
704 do j = 1, nel
705 indtaj = indtm(j) + 5
706 indj = int(j - 1,8) * nelorbju + 1
707 indtmp = indtm(j) + 1
708 ! recomputing work2
709 if(indt4j.eq.0) then
710 call upnewwf(indt, 0, indtm(j), 0, nshelljh, ioptorbj, ioccj, kel(1, j) &
711 &, nel, r, rmu, vju, zeta, rion, work3, work2, nelorbjh, nion, kionj &
712 &, iflagnorm, cnorm(nshell + 1), lbox, rmucos, rmusin, 1d-9&
713 &, indparj_tab, indorbj_tab, indshellj_tab, .true.)
714 ! Put consecutive information
715 do k = 1, 4
716 work2(:, indtm(j) + k) = work2(:, indt + k)
717 enddo
718 else
719 ! Put consecutive information
720 work2(:, 0:indtm(j)) = winvj(:, 0:indtm(j), j)
721 do k = 1, 4
722 work2(:, indtm(j) + k) = winvj(:, indt + k, j)
723 enddo
724 endif
725
726 if(iessz) then
727 ! Recomputing vecu
728 call dgemv('T', nelorbjh, indtaj, 1.d0, work2, nelorbjh, winvjbarsz(indj), 1, 0.d0, vecu, 1)
729 call dgemv('T', nelorbjh, indtaj, 1.d0, work2, nelorbjh, work1(1, 2), 1, 0.d0, vecu(1, 2), 1)
730 if(j.le.nelup) then
731 do k = 1, 4
732 vecub(k + indtmp, 2) = tabpipb(j, k + indt)
733 vecub(k + indtmp, 1) = -tabpipb(j, k + indt)
734 enddo
735 ! do k=1,4
736 ! tabpip(j,k+indt)=tabpip(j,k+indt)+vecu(k+indtmp,2)-vecu(k+indtmp,1)
737 ! enddo
738
739 do k = 1, indtm(j)
740 if(tabpip(j, k).ne.0.d0) then
741 vecub(k + 1, 2) = tabpipb(j, k) * tabpip(j, k)
742 costexp = exp(vecu(k + 1, 2) - vecu(1, 2) - vecu(k + 1, 1) + vecu(1, 1))
743 ! reverse back tabpip to have the same input of the direct algorithm
744 tabpip(j, k) = tabpip(j, k) / costexp
745 tabpipb(j, k) = tabpipb(j, k) * costexp
746 vecub(1, 2) = vecub(1, 2) - vecub(k + 1, 2)
747 vecub(k + 1, 1) = -vecub(k + 1, 2)
748 vecub(1, 1) = vecub(1, 1) + vecub(k + 1, 2)
749 endif
750 enddo
751 ! do k=1,indtm(j)
752 ! if(tabpip(j,k).ne.0.d0) then
753 ! tabpip(j,k)=tabpip(j,k)*exp(vecu(k+1,2)-vecu(1,2)-vecu(k+1,1)+vecu(1,1))
754 ! endif
755 ! enddo
756
757 else
758
759 do k = 1, 4
760 vecub(k + indtmp, 2) = -tabpipb(j, k + indt)
761 vecub(k + indtmp, 1) = -tabpipb(j, k + indt)
762 enddo
763 ! do k=1,4
764 ! tabpip(j,k+indt)=tabpip(j,k+indt)-vecu(k+indtmp,2)-vecu(k+indtmp,1)
765 ! enddo
766
767 do k = 1, indtm(j)
768 ! recomputing wj
769 if(tabpip(j, k).ne.0.d0) then
770 costexp = exp(-vecu(k + 1, 2) + vecu(1, 2) - vecu(k + 1, 1) + vecu(1, 1))
771 vecub(k + 1, 2) = -tabpipb(j, k) * tabpip(j, k)
772 vecub(k + 1, 1) = vecub(k + 1, 2)
773 vecub(1, 2) = vecub(1, 2) - vecub(k + 1, 2)
774 vecub(1, 1) = vecub(1, 1) - vecub(k + 1, 2)
775 ! reverse back tabpip to have the same input of the direct algorithm
776 tabpip(j, k) = tabpip(j, k) / costexp
777 tabpipb(j, k) = tabpipb(j, k) * costexp

1499 grad1b(1:3) = tabpipb(j1, indt + 1:indt + 3)-tabpipb(j2, indt + 1:indt + 3)

1520!$omp parallel do default(shared) private(j1,j2,kk,rc,jastrow1,grad1,grad2,&

1558 &, grad1b, grad2, grad2b, -1, costz(j2), cellscaleb, metricb, car2cryb)
1559

1561 rionb(:, j2) = rionb(:, j2) - rcb(:)
1562
1563 else

1566

1569 &, grad1, grad1b, grad2, grad2b, -1)
1570

1589 ! Differentiation of task1 in reverse (adjoint) mode:

1591 ! of linear combination of output variables: rion kel dist
1592 SUBROUTINE task1_b(kel, kelb, rion, rionb, dist, distb, cellscaleb, s2rb)
1593 IMPLICIT NONE

1598 ! task #1 input kel rion --> output dist el-ion distance to be used later.
1599 if(ncore.gt.0) then ! used only with pseudo
1600!$omp parallel do default(shared) private(i,j) reduction(+:rionb,cellscaleb,s2rb)
1601 do i = 1, nel

1620 SUBROUTINE task2_b(kelind, kelindb, rion, rionb, dist, distb, kel, kelb, &

1630 &, nel)

1649 ! do i=1,istart-1

1653 ! enddo
1654 ! enddo
1655

1664 ! do i=1,istart-1

1667 ! enddo

1673 ivicb(kk, i, j) = ivicb(kk, i, j) + kelb(kk, j, i)

1685 do j = 1, nel

1715 &, versor, wintpseudo, jpseudo, ncore, arg1, indtm(j), &

1717
1718 ! if(iflag.ne.0) return no need already done.
1719
1720 enddo

1725 ! ivicb=0.d0
1726 ! kelb(:,:,1:indt)=0.d0
1727
1728 END IF

1730 END SUBROUTINE task2_b

1739 ! Hint: ISIZE1OFcnorm should be the size of dimension 1 of array cnorm

2369
2370 ! Differentiation of task8 in reverse (adjoint) mode:
2371 ! gradient, with respect to input variables: psip winvbar ainv
2372 ! winv
2373 ! of linear combination of output variables: psip winvbar psidetlnt
2374 ! ainv
2375 SUBROUTINE task8_b(winv, winvb, winvbar, winvbarb, psidetlnt, &
2376 & psidetlntb, ainv, ainvb)
2377 implicit none
2378 real*8 :: winv(ipc * nelorb, 0:indt4, nel), winvbar(ipc * ipf * nelorbh, nel_mat)
2379 real*8 :: winvb(ipc * nelorb, 0:0, nel), winvbarb(ipc * ipf * nelorbh, nel_mat)
2380 real*8 :: psidetlnt, ainv(ipc * nelup_mat, nelup_mat)
2381 real*8 :: psidetlntb(*), ainvb(ipc * nelup_mat, nelup_mat)
2382 real*8, allocatable :: ainv_sav(:, :)
2383 complex*16 costpsic
2384 real*8 costpsi
2385 integer k
2386 complex*16 psicomp
2387 ! reverse algorithm of:
2388 ! A and B rectangular matrices with same dimensions, sam raws and columns
2389 ! nelorbh, nelup
2390 ! y=psidetlnt
2391 ! A=winv(1:nelorbh,0,1:nelup)
2392 ! B=winvbar(1:nelorbh,nelup+1:2*nelup)
2393 ! winvbar=detmat*winv costrained
2394 ! Here ainv = (A^T B)^-1 given in input
2395 ! Output y and C (square matrix = ainv)
2396 ! y=ReTr ln (A^T B)
2397 ! C=(A^T B)^-1
2398
2399 ! ainv (C) known in input assumed (no recompute the inverse)
2400
2401
2402 ! first dependence on y
2403 if(ieslog) then
2404 ! NB the pfaffian is the square root of the det that's why the factor 1/2
2405 if(ipf.eq.2) psidetlntb(1:ipc) = psidetlntb(1:ipc) / 2.d0
2406 if(ipc.eq.2) then
2407 costpsic = dcmplx(psidetlntb(1), psidetlntb(2))
2408
2409 ! psicomp=dcmplx(psidetlntb)
2410 if(ipf.eq.2) then
2411 ! ainv is the reverse vector obtained after applying
2412 ! the back propagation to y=1/2 tr[ log A] --> ainv^T
2413 if(ndiff.ne.0) then
2414 allocate(ainv_sav(2 * nelup_mat, nelup_mat))
2415#ifdef _OFFLOAD
2416!$omp target update from (ainv)
2417#endif
2418 ainv_sav = ainv
2419
2420 if(npar_eagp.gt.0) call update_eagp_complex(.true., costpsic, ndiff, nelup_mat, ainv, eagp_pfaffb)
2421
2422#ifdef _OFFLOAD
2423!$omp target teams distribute parallel do collapse(2)
2424#endif
2425 do k = 1, ndiff
2426 do i = 1, nelup_mat - ndiff
2427 ainv(2 * nelup_mat - 2 * k + 1, i) = ainv(2 * nelup_mat - 2 * k + 1, i) - ainv(2 * i - 1, nelup_mat - k + 1)
2428 ainv(2 * nelup_mat - 2 * k + 2, i) = ainv(2 * nelup_mat - 2 * k + 2, i) - ainv(2 * i, nelup_mat - k + 1)
2429 enddo
2430 enddo
2431#ifdef _OFFLOAD
2432!$omp end target teams distribute parallel do
2433#endif
2434 endif
2435
2436 call conjmat_(nelorbh, nel, winv, nelorb5)
2437 call zgemm_('N', 'C', nelorbh, nelup_mat, nelup, costpsic, winv, nelorb5&
2438 &, ainv, nelup_mat, zone, winvbarb, 2 * nelorbh)
2439 call zgemm_('N', 'C', nelorbh, nelup_mat, neldo, costpsic, winv(1, 0, nelup1)&
2440 &, nelorb5, ainv(1, nelup1), nelup_mat, zone, winvbarb(2 * nelorbh + 1, 1), 2 * nelorbh)
2441 ! restore winv
2442 call conjmat_(nelorbh, nel, winv, nelorb5)
2443 call conjmat_(nelup_mat, nelup_mat, ainv, nelup_mat)
2444 call conjmat_(2 * nelorbh, nelup_mat, winvbar, 2 * nelorbh)
2445 call zgemm_('N', 'N', nelorbh, nelup, nelup_mat, costpsic, winvbar&
2446 &, 2 * nelorbh, ainv, nelup_mat, zone, winvb, nelorbh)
2447 call zgemm_('N', 'N', nelorbh, neldo, nelup_mat, costpsic&
2448 &, winvbar(2 * nelorbh + 1, 1), 2 * nelorbh, ainv(1, nelup1), nelup_mat, zone&
2449 &, winvb(1, 0, nelup1), nelorbh)
2450 ! restore ainv, winvbar
2451 call conjmat_(nelup_mat, nelup_mat, ainv, nelup_mat)
2452 call conjmat_(2 * nelorbh, nelup_mat, winvbar, 2 * nelorbh)
2453 if(ndiff.ne.0) then
2454 ainv = ainv_sav
2455#ifdef _OFFLOAD
2456!$omp target update to (ainv)
2457#endif
2458 deallocate(ainv_sav)
2459 endif
2460
2461 else
2462 call conjmat_(nelorbh, nelup, winv, nelorb5)
2463 call zgemm_('N', 'C', nelorbh, nelup, nelup, costpsic, winv, nelorb5&
